questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Subsurface Soil Exploration, Boring Methods, Standard Penetration Test, Cone Penetration Test
questions.text: Explain Site Investigation and Subsoil Exploration: Objectives, Depth and Spacing of Boreholes, Methods of Drilling, Soil Sampling (Disturbed vs Undisturbed samples, Area Ratio). Explain Standard Penetration Test (SPT - N-value with Overburden and Dilatancy corrections) and Cone Penetration Test (CPT).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Bearing Capacity of Shallow Foundations
questions.text: Explain Terzaghi's Bearing Capacity Theory for shallow strip footing: $q_{ult} = c N_c + q N_q + 0.5 \gamma B N_\gamma$. State assumptions and modifications for square/circular footings and water table effect. Compare with Meyerhof's, Hansen's, and Vesic's bearing capacity equations.
Explain Plate Load Test for determining bearing capacity and settlement of foundation. State limitations and scale effect of plate load test.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Design of Raft/Mat Foundations & Combined Footings
questions.text: Explain Deep Foundations: Classification of Piles (Friction, End-Bearing, Compaction piles). Calculate load carrying capacity of Single Pile and Pile Group in clay and sand ($Q_g = n Q_u$ vs block failure) and determine Group Efficiency ($\eta_g$). Explain Negative Skin Friction.

questions.chapter: Chapter 7: Retaining Structures, Sheet Piles & Braced Excavations
questions.text: Explain Well Foundations (Caissons: Open, Pneumatic, Box Caissons). Draw cross-section of a Well Foundation showing cutting edge, well curb, steining, bottom plug, sand filling, and top plug. Explain forces acting and stability analysis of well foundations.
